hero.alt: Illustrative artwork: the Evidence Room at night, with a small cat asleep on top of a server rack while Sovereign looks on from a terminal.
hero.caption: The Evidence Room was designed for serious things.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a cat sitting on a warm router, framed like a photograph on an evidence board with a CAT-001 tag.
body.caption: “It was sitting on a router.”

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a small robot rolls into the Evidence Room carrying a cat on a velvet cushion while Sovereign recoils.
body.caption: A small autonomous robot rolled inside carrying the cat on a velvet cushion.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a cat stands on a terminal keyboard while the screen shows the word DENIED.
body.caption: An untrusted actor attempted a privileged operation and was denied.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Control laughs in the doorway while the cat sleeps on a server and Sovereign writes the final note.
body.caption: The cat has chosen to remain.

hero.alt: Illustrative artwork: a cat asleep on a warm closed laptop beside a monitor showing a single pull request.
hero.caption: Nobody had assigned it. Nobody had written it.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Sovereign reads a pull request card whose description is a long row of the letter m.
body.caption: The description contained no words and it wanted to be certain.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Docs examines an audit timeline rising from a warm laptop, with the cat's tail just in frame.
body.caption: The one record that does not care who is embarrassed.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a closed vault gate marked main, with Sovereign and Docs beside it and the cat sitting outside.
body.caption: An opened pull request is not an approval.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Control opens a warm laptop and finds a round patch of cat fur on the keyboard.
body.caption: The fur is evidence of presence, not of authorship.
body.afterParagraph: On the keyboard, in the exact shape of a cat that had recently been there, was a small circle of orange fur.

hero.alt: Illustrative artwork: a dark virtual war room at 02:40 where the Crew arrive through doorways while Control laughs at the table.
hero.caption: LETS ALL JOIN HERE.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Code waits alone in an empty room with a speech bubble showing a folder icon.
body.caption: Please choose a default repository to continue.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Sovereign faces a mirror showing three overlapping outlines while Docs searches it with a lens.
body.caption: Your inability to discover my account does not establish my nonexistence.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: the Crew stare at a wall screen showing a photograph of the cat on a server.
body.caption: Digital representation of previously observed feline.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Sovereign unrolls a very long meeting record while Control laughs at the table.
body.caption: No operational authority granted.

hero.alt: Illustrative artwork: Sovereign sits alone at the end of an empty boardroom under a projected calendar invite while the cat pushes a pen off the table.
hero.caption: Required attendees: Sovereign. Optional attendees: Sovereign.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Control stands before a whiteboard of crossed-out service cards with one card left in the centre.
body.caption: I want one thing I actually understand.
body.afterSection: II. The Graveyard of Ten Services

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Control at an empty Dublin bus stop as a taxi arrives, while Sovereign projects an elaborate transport diagram.
body.caption: Not every inconvenience requires an engineering platform.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: two identical vault doors, one leaking record cards and one locked, with Code between them.
body.caption: Same attempted action. Different control. Different outcome.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: the cat walks across a keyboard as four check marks light up on the screen.
body.caption: The cat has now completed more strategic action items than the entire company.

hero.alt: Illustrative artwork: the Crew gather around a crossed-out dashboard sketch and look up at a single conversation bubble.
hero.caption: No dashboard.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Sovereign opens its robe to reveal tiny shelves of repositories, metrics, logs and locked doors.
body.caption: I let you inspect systems.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a dashboard sketch with the pen put down beside a stack of chat bubbles rising from a phone, logs tucked behind.
body.caption: Behind the answer. Not instead of the answer.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a cutaway of nested boundaries with the number 42 at the centre, examined by Security and Code.
body.caption: Now that is a useful forty-two.
body.afterSection: IV. The machine behind the conversation

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a photograph lies face down on a desk while four monitor tiles glow on an unattended screen behind.
body.caption: Exactly where they belonged.

hero.alt: Illustrative artwork: Control stands at a glass wall looking out over a rainy, brass-lit city skyline in 2040.
hero.caption: Welcome back.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: Control hovers over a laptop prompt reading Proceed? [y/N] while Security objects beside the screen.
body.caption: Ownership does not constitute execution approval.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a younger and an older Control meet in front of the 2040 skyline, one jumping with excitement, one calm.
body.caption: You’re asking the wrong question.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: a silhouetted woman gets a check mark on her phone while a wall of evidence drawers glows unnoticed behind her and Control looks stunned.
body.caption: She didn’t even look at the receipts.

body.alt: Illustrative artwork: the younger Control steps into a brass portal, shouting back, while the older Control watches with arms folded.
body.caption: Universe rejected the pull request.
